definitions.explanation: To put together with something else.

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}を{加|くわ}える。
{変更|へんこう}を{加|くわ}える。

notes:
{加|くわ}える is an ichidan verb meaning to add or append.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {加|くわ}わる (intransitive - to join, be added)

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- AにBを{加|くわ}える: to add B to A
- {説明|せつめい}を{加|くわ}える: to add an explanation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変更|へんこう}を{加|くわ}える: to make changes
- {手|て}を{加|くわ}える: to modify, work on
- {攻撃|こうげき}を{加|くわ}える: to attack (inflict an attack)
- {危害|きがい}を{加|くわ}える: to harm

DON'T CONFUSE:
- {加|くわ}える: to add
- {咥|くわ}える: to hold in mouth (different kanji and meaning)
